summary: The remaining #version mismatch is the same build-identity conflict as the earlier v32 version-build-options case. C uses the Unix VERSION_ID from the Linux recorder, while js/version.js hardcodes the MacOS VERSION_ID used by the historical judge environment. version.c:doextversion() prints that version string before the feature report. A source-faithful choice requires a shared build-provenance input; changing either literal would only specialize one build.

source.branch: The #version command reaches doextversion() and calls getversionstring() before it emits runtime feature text. getversionstring() starts from nomakedefs.version_id, generated by makedefs.c from PORT_ID; include/global.h selects Unix for the recorder build and MacOS for __APPLE__. The JS owner uses RECORDER_VERSION_ID="MacOS NetHack Version 5.0.0...".
callers: cmd.c:doextcmd dispatches extended command version to version.c:doextversion.
dependencies: Shared build-platform identity/PORT_ID provenance must be resolved before any general implementation can match both Linux C recordings and historical MacOS judge inputs.

evidence: Current saved v35 evaluation at accepted commit 07a7711f3c33616a45a45bdd323eee7001502b7c records 35/36 screens, 2697/2697 RNG calls, and 36/36 cursors. Its first difference is step 10, screen row 0 column 0: C begins "Unix NetHack Version 5.0.0" and JS begins "MacOS NetHack Version 5.0.0".

Read the selected independent recipe: it invokes .#version after startup; the admitted C screen at step 10 confirms the complete Unix version banner and later compile-feature report. The screen mismatch is already before any feature-option list branch.

Read upstream version.c:169-196: doextversion() creates a text window, calls getversionstring(), and puts that returned string before the runtime feature report. version.c:35-62 shows getversionstring() begins with nomakedefs.version_id.

Read upstream include/global.h:184-226: PORT_ID resolves to "Unix" under UNIX and "MacOS" under __APPLE__. Read util/makedefs.c:1874-1875: VERSION_ID is emitted from version_id_string(). The compiled recorder uses the Unix build while the historical judge identity retained by js/version.js:16-17 is MacOS.

The earlier v32-version-build-options diagnosis in the shared ledger independently identifies the same Unix/MacOS PORT_ID and DEV_RANDOM configuration conflict and is parked pending the general build/evaluation contract. This v35 session adds another observed call path but no independent code scope.

A one-sided edit to the C or JS version literal would make one platform correct and the other wrong. Do not claim source completion until the coordinator resolves a source-faithful build-provenance contract.

resolution.reason: This repeats the v32 Linux recorder versus Darwin judge compile-time platform label mismatch and adds no independent portable game behavior or source scope.
resolution.disposition: Retain the Darwin judge profile and preserve the admitted v35 recording, manifest, and evaluations unchanged. Exclude this duplicate platform-only mismatch from JavaScript implementation work.
